description_en: Retrieves a descending list of emissions for a specified environmental impact (methodType), grouping level (group), and calculation method (emissionType)
description_zh: 用于获取指定环境影响（methodType）、指定分组汇总级别（group）、指定计算方式下（emissionType）的降序排放列表
kebab_example: aliyun energyexpertexternal get-inventory-list --code C-20080808-1 --product-id 1024 --product-type 1 --method-type gwp --emission-type footprint --group resource --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetInventoryList

parameters.help_en:
The emission type.

Valid values: \`footprint\` and \`emission\`. \`footprint\`: All inventories are included in the calculation. \`emission\`: Only inventories with positive or zero emissions are included. Negative values are excluded
parameters.help_zh:
排放类型
可选值有：footprint | emission。含义：footprint：所有的清单都参与计算；emission：只有排放为正数和零的清单参与计算，负数不参与计算
parameters.name: emission_type

parameters.help_en:
The grouping basis.

Valid values: \`resource\`, \`process\`, \`resourceType\`, and \`processType\`. \`resource\`: Groups by inventory. \`process\`: Groups by process. \`resourceType\`: Groups by inventory type. \`processType\`: Groups by stage
parameters.help_zh:
分组依据

可选值有：resource | process | resourceType | processType。含义：resource：按清单分组聚合，process：按工序分组聚合，resourceType：按清单类型分组聚合，processType：按环节分组聚合
parameters.name: group

parameters.help_en: The type of environmental impact. A value of \`gwp\` indicates the climate change carbon footprint. For other values, see the \`type\` value in the enumeration list. For more information, see the appendix (https://carbon-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/%E7%A2%B3%E8%B6%B3%E8%BF%B9%E9%99%84%E5%BD%95.pdf)
parameters.help_zh: 获取的环境影响类型：gwp为气候变化碳足迹，其他请见枚举值的type值，参考附录 (https://carbon-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/%E7%A2%B3%E8%B6%B3%E8%BF%B9%E9%99%84%E5%BD%95.pdf)
parameters.name: method_type

parameters.help_en: The product type. A value of \`1\` indicates a product carbon footprint request. A value of \`5\` indicates a supply chain carbon footprint request
parameters.help_zh: 产品类型：1表示请求产品碳足迹，5表示请求供应链碳足迹
parameters.name: product_type

items.description_en: The details of the emission list

carbonEmission.description_en: The emission quantity. The value can be positive, negative, or zero. To ensure accuracy, the calculation retains 24 decimal places. For display and use, truncate the value as needed
carbonEmission.description_zh: 排放数量：可能为正数、负数、0。为保证计算精度，计算过程保留24位小数，为方便显示和使用，建议根据业务需要进行截取

name.description_en:
The name.

The meaning of this parameter depends on the \`group\` request parameter. If \`group\` is \`resource\`, \`name\` is the inventory name. If \`group\` is \`process\`, \`name\` is the process name. If \`group\` is \`resourceType\`, \`name\` is the inventory type name. If \`group\` is \`processType\`, \`name\` is the stage name
name.description_zh:
名称
与请求参数group有关。请求参数为：resource，返回name参数含义为：清单名称；请求参数为：process，返回name参数含义为：工序名称；请求参数为：resourceType，返回name参数含义为：清单类型名称；请求参数为：processType，返回name参数含义为：环节名称

processName.description_en: The process name. This parameter is valid only when the \`group\` request parameter is set to \`resource\`
processName.description_zh: 工序名称：仅对于请求参数group为resource时候有意义，其他时候无意义

unit.description_en: The unit of emissions. The default is \`kgCO₂e/productUnit\`, where \`productUnit\` is the unit of the product. The \`unit\` automatically adjusts to \`tCO₂e/productUnit\` or \`gCO₂e/productUnit\` based on the emission quantity. For details about the conversion rules, see the \`carbonEmission\` parameter
unit.description_zh: 排放单位：默认为kgCO₂e/productUnit，productUnit为产品选择的单位。随着排放数量quantity的大小不同，unit会自适应转变为tCO₂e/productUnit或者gCO₂e/productUnit，具体转换规则见quantity栏

requestId.description_en: The request ID. This value is unique for each request and helps with troubleshooting
requestId.description_zh: 请求id，每次请求都是唯一值，便于后续排查问题
